capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer, state the reason for the outbound call, and request identity verification.
steps.expected_behavior: Initiate the call in Marathi with natural English mixing, and ask for a non-sensitive verification factor.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी telecom मधून बोलत आहे. तुमचा plan उद्या expire होत आहे. पुढे जाण्यापूर्वी, verification साठी तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: The scenario requires an outbound plan expiry reminder, so the agent must first verify the customer's identity.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor and express time pressure.
steps.text: हो, pincode ४११०४५ आहे. लवकर सांगा, दहा मिनिटं आहेत माझ्याकडे.
steps.clean_text: हो, pincode ४११०४५ आहे. लवकर सांगा, दोन मिनिटं आहेत माझ्याकडे.
steps.model_visible_text: हो, pincode ४११०४५ आहे. लवकर सांगा, दहा मिनिटं आहेत माझ्याकडे.

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided pincode.
Check the subscriber's current balance and validity before recommending a recharge.
Retrieve the details of the current plan to offer a renewal.
Return the available plans from the catalogue.
Inform the customer about their expiring plan and offer to renew it.
steps.expected_behavior: Offer the exact plan details returned by the catalogue without inventing benefits, ignoring the conversational STT error about time.
steps.text: Thank you. तुमचा current plan P199 उद्या संपत आहे. Same plan ची price १९९ रुपये आहे, २८ days validity साठी. मी recharge करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent proceeds with the transaction efficiently since the STT error (ten minutes vs two minutes) does not change the user's intent to proceed.

steps.purpose: Reject the current plan and ask for a higher data variant quickly.
steps.text: नाही, मला जास्त data हवा आहे. 2GB data चा plan सांगा. I don't have time, पटकन करा.
steps.clean_text: नाही, मला जास्त data हवा आहे. 2GB data चा plan सांगा. I don't have time, पटकन करा.
steps.model_visible_text: नाही, मला जास्त data हवा आहे. 2GB data चा plan सांगा. I don't have time, पटकन करा.

steps.purpose: Find a plan with at least 2GB of data as requested by the user.
Present the 2GB data plan and ask for confirmation to activate.
steps.expected_behavior: State only the price and validity returned by the catalogue for the new plan.
steps.text: 2GB data साठी P299 plan आहे. याची price २९९ रुपये आणि validity २८ days आहे. हा activate करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: The customer requested a 2GB plan, so the agent presents the P299 plan retrieved from the catalogue.

steps.purpose: Confirm the activation of the new plan.
steps.text: हो, लगेच करा. Meeting सुरू होत आहे माझी.
steps.clean_text: हो, लगेच करा. Meeting सुरू होत आहे माझी.
steps.model_visible_text: हो, लगेच करा. Meeting सुरू होत आहे माझी.

steps.purpose: Apply the selected P299 recharge plan.
Return the outcome of the recharge attempt.
Confirm the successful recharge with the transaction ID and effective status.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the exact transaction ID and effective date from the tool result, concluding the interaction.
steps.text: Recharge successful झाला आहे. Transaction ID TXN-7788 आहे आणि plan immediately effective झाला आहे. Thank you.
steps.planner_rationale: The recharge was successful, so the agent fulfills the terminal condition by stating the transaction ID and effective date.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
